directory-chromeosdevices-action.description: Takes an action that affects a Chrome OS Device. This includes deprovisioning, disabling, and re-enabling devices. *Warning:* * Deprovisioning a device will stop device policy syncing and remove device-level printers. After a device is deprovisioned, it must be wiped before it can be re-enrolled. * Lost or stolen devices should use the disable action. * Re-enabling a disabled device will consume a device license. For example, the timespan of events summarized in a report can start in April and end in May. The report itself can be requested in August.
